thread.title: Samsung adds iTunes to smart TVs - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Clark Schultz
title: Samsung adds iTunes to smart TVs - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Samsung ( OTC:SSNLF ) strikes a deal with Apple to include an iTunes movies/TV app and AirPlay 2 capabilities on 2019 smart TVs and AirPlay2. The company is also adding the app to 2018 smart TVs through a firmware update.
Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL ) decision to free up the iTunes ecosystem is indicative of the growing importance of services revenue to the company and the huge investment out of Cupertino in TV content. It also leads The Verge to ask the pressing question of why would any Samsung smart TV owner buy an Apple TV box now?
